description: Cross-implementation test vectors for the Oxy Keychain (oxy ADR 0063 D8). Generated by @oxy.so/core (packages/core/src/crypto/keychain/__tests__/vectorGenerator.ts) from fixed keys, ephemeral keys and nonces; @oxy.so/core and the OxyOS keychain service must both reproduce every value byte for byte. Binary values are base64url without padding; hashes are lowercase hex; text fields (bodies, signing inputs, JCS, keyring plaintexts) are the exact UTF-8 strings. The shape is documented in docs/identity/keychain.md#test-vectors.
